plan.audience_intent: Inform AI tool evaluators with a source-bound update.

candidates.angle: What the dated Enterprise assistant announcement confirms and leaves open.
evidence_requirements: Use only stated announcement facts and identify the named omissions.
must_cover_points: unstated pricing, certification, geography, benchmarks, rollout, deployment, and comparison details
candidates.reader_promise: Separate confirmed access and feature facts from the details evaluators cannot yet infer.
candidates.relevance: AI tool evaluators need a bounded view of an announced Enterprise assistant.

candidates.angle: What an evaluator can confirm now versus what remains unavailable.
evidence_requirements: Do not infer an omitted category from the product name or plan.
candidates.reader_promise: Give evaluators a source-bound checklist without treating omissions as product claims.
candidates.relevance: The announced availability and controls are useful only with clear limits on unknown details.

plan.selection_rationale: The confirmed-update angle keeps provider claims and omissions visibly separate.
plan.why_now: The source records a September 20, 2026 announcement with October 2026 availability.
